evidence_required: Decision record; power, cooling, CDU, and floor arithmetic for the chosen option; the fabric change with switch and link counts.

marking.criterion: At least three options with criteria, each checked against the rack, power, CDU and floor limits
Arithmetic for the chosen option correct (for example 16 DLC racks at 36.75 kW, 470.4 kW liquid on two CDUs at 78.4 %, IT under 800 kW, floor 1,139 kg/m2)
Consistent fabric change (16 rail leaves, 8 spines, 512 host links, 512 leaf-spine links, 24 switches)
Honesty about constraints that cannot be met (rack positions must be reclaimed; no N+1 CDU without a third unit)

title: Growing ORION to 512 GPUs in the same hall
